about_the_game:
Under the Crimson Moon, vengeful spirits roam freely. You must traverse lands of ominous aura, purify the filth with thunderous arts, and embark on a path to slay demons—a journey that will also unveil the truth behind the celestial anomaly. This simple roguelike game will bring you an extraordinary legendary experience.

To vanquish demons and evil spirits, players must cultivate various techniques, upgrade magical artifacts, and enhance their own strength within the game.

Available techniques for cultivation include:

  • Dragon Blood Sacred Body: Greatly enhances vitality and defense.

  • Reincarnation Cultivation: Elevating the reincarnation level grants bonuses to health, attack, and defense.

Players can also upgrade the following divine weapons, a crucial aspect of the demon-slaying journey:

  • Vajra Pestle: Increases attack power and damage boost attributes.

  • Bagua Mirror: Boosts numerous attributes, primarily reducing damage taken from other players.

  • Xuanyuan Sword: The most powerful divine artifact in history! Significantly boosts attack power.

After strengthening their abilities, players can enter the secret realm—a place teeming with endless demons and monsters. Slaying these evils offers chances to obtain various cultivation resources, paving the way to break through the demonic defenses and uncover the ultimate truth!
